questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Lane reduction; the right lane ends soon.
Lane reduction; the left lane ends soon.

questions.correctAnswerText: Lane reduction; the right lane ends soon.
questions.explanation: This sign tells you the right lane is ending.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Keep to the side indicated by the arrow.
You may drive in the left lane.

questions.correctAnswerText: Keep to the side indicated by the arrow.
questions.explanation: This is a "Keep right" sign. A traffic island, median, or barrier is ahead. You must stay to the right of it.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a flagger is ahead controlling traffic in a construction area.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that traffic is merging in from the right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Watch for people crossing your path.

questions.explanation: This orange warning sign alerts you that road work is coming. Stay alert for temporary traffic control devices in the work zone.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Traffic signals arranged vertically have red on top and green on bottom. Signals arranged horizontally have red on the left and green on the right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign alerts you that a side road intersection is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are usually yellow and black and prepare you for upcoming road conditions and hazards. This sign tells you a lane is ending and you need to let traffic merge safely.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a flagger is ahead. Always follow the flagger's directions. Flaggers wear orange or yellow vests, yellow-green shirts, or bright jackets. They use paddles and red flags to direct traffic through work zones and let construction vehicles or workers cross the road.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Watch for traffic on your right.
Don’t park on the right side of the street.

questions.explanation: A red circle with a slash means the action shown is not allowed. In this case, a right turn is prohibited.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road ahead has many curves.
There is a sharp curve in the road ahead.
The road ahead may be slippery.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead may be slippery.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that the road ahead may be slippery when wet.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: There is a steep hill ahead.
No trucks are allowed on the upcoming hill.

questions.correctAnswerText: There is a steep hill ahead.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign warns you about a steep hill ahead. Slow down and be ready to control your speed to protect your brakes.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A divided highway is starting ahead. The road will split into two separate one-way roads with a median or divider between them. Stay in the right lane.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A round sign means a railroad crossing is ahead. The sign is posted a few hundred feet before the tracks. Slow down, look and listen, and be ready to stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you that a divided highway is starting ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Stop at the crosswalk until a crossing guards signals for you to go.
Be prepared to stop if children are in the crosswalk.

questions.correctAnswerText: Be prepared to stop if children are in the crosswalk.
questions.explanation: A five-sided sign means you are near a school. Be aware and stop if children are crossing.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Reserved parking for persons with disabilities.

questions.explanation: This sign warns you that two lanes of traffic will soon merge into one lane.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Pedestrians walking along the road ahead.
Be alert for construction workers on the road.

questions.explanation: This sign warns that a pedestrian crossing is ahead. Be cautious and watch for pedestrians.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings and prepare you for upcoming hazards. This sign tells you that a stop sign is ahead. Slow down and be ready to stop completely.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Orange signs are used only for construction and maintenance warnings.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you the direction traffic must flow on a one-way street. You must drive in the direction shown by the arrow.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You must come to a complete stop.

questions.correctAnswerText: You must come to a complete stop.
questions.explanation: An octagonal sign always means stop. You must come to a complete stop at the marked stop line. If there is no stop line, stop before the crosswalk. If there is no crosswalk, stop before the intersection where you can see oncoming traffic. Only proceed when it is safe.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: May pass a slow-moving vehicle if you can do so quickly.
May pass if you know the road ahead.
May pass, but only at night.

questions.explanation: This is a regulatory sign. It is white and rectangular with black markings. Where this sign is posted, you cannot pass other vehicles.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This regulatory sign prohibits right turns. You cannot turn right where this sign is posted.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign is placed at the start of one-way streets and ramps. It tells you that you cannot continue driving in your current direction.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This is a warning sign. It is usually yellow with black markings. It warns you that the road curves to the right ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a traffic signal is coming. Slow down and be ready to stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A round sign always means a railroad crossing is coming. Be prepared to stop if necessary.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This is a warning sign. It is usually yellow with black markings. It warns you that another road crosses the highway ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that the road ahead has a series of curves and turns.
